title: Grateful Dead Live at The Warehouse on 1970-02-01
lineage: SBD > Bill Gadsen Reels > C > DAT > WAV > SHN

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality historic clip highlighted by an epic, extended Lovelight performance.
ai_review.review: The reviews rave about the historic nature of this recording and consistently praise the lengthy, trippy rendition of Lovelight, calling it a standout moment. Sound quality is described as good, though no specific source type is identified, making the tape enjoyable despite its mystery.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are 4‑5 stars and emphasize strong musical moments (especially Lovelight) with generally positive comments about sound, yielding a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note "good sound" and an overall clear listening experience; no mention of drop‑outs or major distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Specific set‑list details are scarce; reviewers focus on the extended Lovelight and historic context rather than overall pacing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar tone is praised, with one reviewer noting his Fender Twin out‑shining Peter Green’s amp.
